# Black metal shield

Internal ID: ShieldBlackmetal | Type: Shield | Source: Forge | Usage: Blocking | Wielding: Off-hand | Crafting Materials: Finewood x20, Black metal x8, Chain x4 | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Black metal shield is the fourth round shield. It has lower block power compared to the Black metal tower shield when used to block, but may be used to parry enemy attacks.

## Notes

• When crafting, players can customize the shield with a few different pre-set designs and colors by clicking the style button beneath the item name in the crafting window. The design can not be changed afterward.
